result.summary: The home screen has several layout clipping problems: restaurant names and category chips are cut off, the promo banner sits too close to the search field, and the last popular card is cropped by the tab bar.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in 'Fastest near you' clips the name 'Trattoria Piccol' at the right edge of the screen.
issues.suggestion: Give the horizontal list enough padding or allow cards to scroll fully so names and prices are never truncated.

issues.description: The last category chip is only partially visible on the right, so users cannot tell what the next filter is.
issues.suggestion: Add end padding or a fade/peek so the last chip is fully readable or clearly indicates more options.

issues.description: The second popular restaurant card is cut off by the bottom tab bar, hiding most of the restaurant name and details.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content inset so the last card can scroll fully above the tab bar.

issues.description: The green promo banner sits very close to the search field with almost no gap, making the header feel cramped.
issues.suggestion: Increase vertical spacing between the search bar and the promo card.

issues.description: The pizza card shows a '-100%' badge, which looks like a broken or placeholder discount rather than a real offer.
issues.suggestion: Replace with a valid discount value or hide the badge when the percentage is invalid.
